s1.text:
How to try it: press Play on the prototype. Pick a question on home, step through with Next.

Each screen is a dashboard panel, enlarged: the column's icon, name and question; the row tag; the pill that sets it; the panel's own rail with names; a keyed chart; the note line. The mini-map (top right) shows where it lives; click it, or any other rail view, to jump to the dashboard.

All figures are illustrative.

s2.text:
Rules every walk follows:
1. A question a teacher would ask, as a button.
2. Same rhythm: this year → in context → over time → wider.
3. One view per screen, with a written answer above it.
4. The dashboard's own icons, names, colours and pills; every chart keyed.
